detect.note: Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon keep one copy of the save, ending in a table of its blocks that starts 0x200 bytes from the end and holds BEEF at 0x10.

pk7.note: A stored Pokémon after pk67-crypt, its blocks in the order A, B, C, D.

spaces.name: save
spaces.note: The whole save. Each block is padded to the next multiple of 0x200, and the block table at 0x6CA00 keeps each block's length, id and checksum. The signature in block 36 covers the table's first 0x150 bytes, so it's computed after every block's checksum, and block 36's checksum reads it as zero.

ranges.name: Signature
ranges.note: Block 36 from 0x100: the memecrypto-sign signature over the block table. PKHeX clears it when it loads a save.

ranges.name: Saved at
ranges.note: A timestamp the console keeps as a secure value.

ranges.name: Saved at before
ranges.note: The timestamp of the save before.

ranges.name: Trainer ID
ranges.note: The game shows the trainer ID and secret ID as one six-digit ID, the two read as a u32 mod 1,000,000, and a four-digit secret ID, that u32 divided by 1,000,000.

ranges.name: Game
ranges.note: 32 for Ultra Sun, 33 for Ultra Moon.

ranges.name: Event flags
ranges.note: 4,960 flags.

ranges.name: Spinda flags
ranges.note: Which of the four Spinda PIDs at 0x8E8 are set and which the Pokédex shows.

ranges.name: Pokédex owned flags
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n, for 1 to 807.

ranges.name: Pokédex seen flags
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n, for 1 to 807. The bits after them mark forms. Male or genderless, not shiny. PKHeX counts a species seen when any of the four seen regions marks it.

ranges.name: Pokédex seen female flags
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n, for 1 to 807. The bits after them mark forms.

ranges.name: Pokédex seen shiny flags
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n, for 1 to 807. The bits after them mark forms. Male or genderless.

ranges.name: Pokédex seen shiny female flags
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n, for 1 to 807. The bits after them mark forms.

ranges.name: Pokédex language flags

ranges.name: Spinda PIDs

spaces.name: misc
spaces.note: Block 9, money, stamps and Battle Points.

ranges.name: Stamps
ranges.note: One bit for each of the 15 stamps on the trainer passport.

ranges.name: Adventure started
ranges.note: Seconds from 2000-01-01.

ranges.name: Hall of Fame entered
ranges.note: Seconds from 2000-01-01.

ranges.name: Battle teams
ranges.note: Six teams of six box slots, each the box times 30 plus the slot, or -1.

ranges.name: Battle team locks
ranges.note: 1 when a team is locked, team 6 first.

ranges.name: Box flags
ranges.note: Which wallpapers are unlocked.

ranges.name: Box Pokémon
ranges.note: 32 boxes of 30.

ranges.name: Last saved
ranges.note: The date and time packed into bit fields.

tid.note: The stored 16-bit trainer ID. The game shows the six-digit ID worked out from it and the secret ID.

seen.note: The male or genderless, not shiny region. The engine counts a species seen in any of the four.

friendship.note: The engine shows the original trainer's friendship while the original trainer holds the Pokémon.

hatch-counter.note: An egg keeps its hatch counter in the original trainer's friendship byte.
